stories.title: E-mails indicam que Flávio dividiu conta bancária com advogado investigado na fraude do INSS

en.title: Emails indicate that Flávio shared bank account with lawyer investigated in INSS fraud
en.summary: Emails suggest that Flávio shared a bank account with a lawyer under investigation for alleged involvement in social security fraud.

stories.title: Campanha de Lula vê interferência da Meta após vídeos do petista baterem recorde de visualizações

en.title: Lula's campaign sees Meta interference after president's videos break viewership records
en.summary: Lula's campaign alleges that Meta is restricting the president's profile reach on its platforms after the profile achieved record video views.

stories.title: Emails indicam que Flávio Bolsonaro dividia conta com suspeito de lavar dinheiro do INSS

en.title: Emails indicate that Flávio Bolsonaro shared account with suspect in INSS money laundering
en.summary: Federal Police emails suggest presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro maintained a shared bank account with a lawyer suspected of involvement in social security fraud money laundering. Both deny the allegations.

stories.title: Seleção feminina faz gol de bicicleta e ganha com facilidade da Argentina

en.title: Women's team scores bicycle kick and easily defeats Argentina
en.summary: Brazil's women's football team defeated Argentina 3-1 with a bicycle kick goal among their scorers, with nearly 28,400 spectators attending in Porto Alegre.

stories.title: TSE dá 48 horas para que Meta esclareça possível restrição a posts da campanha de Lula

en.title: TSE gives Meta 48 hours to clarify possible restriction on Lula campaign posts
en.summary: Brazil's electoral authority has given Meta a deadline to explain potential restrictions placed on posts from President Lula's reelection campaign.

stories.title: Ministro da Secom, Sidônio deve tirar férias para participar da campanha de Lula à Presidência

en.title: Communication Minister Sidônio to take leave to participate in Lula's presidential campaign
en.summary: Brazil's Communication Ministry chief will take vacation starting Monday to strengthen President Lula's reelection campaign communications team ahead of the second round voting.

stories.title: Praia do Forte, em Cabo Frio, tem mar calmo e tempo firme às vésperas do feriado de Nossa Senhora Aparecida

en.title: Forte Beach in Cabo Frio has calm seas and clear weather on the eve of Our Lady of Aparecida holiday
en.summary: Cabo Frio's popular Forte Beach is experiencing favorable weather and calm seas during the extended holiday weekend, with increased cleaning services prepared for higher tourist numbers.

stories.title: Brasil x Argentina: onde assistir ao vivo e horário do amistoso da seleção feminina

en.title: Brazil vs Argentina: where to watch live and kickoff time for women's team friendly
en.summary: Information on viewing options and timing for an upcoming women's soccer friendly match between Brazil and Argentina national teams.

stories.title: Campanha de Lula acusa Meta de interferência eleitoral e vai acionar o TSE

en.title: Lula campaign accuses Meta of electoral interference and will take action with TSE
en.summary: Lula's campaign has accused Meta of interfering in the election and announced it will file a complaint with Brazil's electoral authority.

stories.title: Douglas Ruas é eleito governador do RJ, após retotalização de votos

en.title: Douglas Ruas is elected governor of RJ after vote recount
en.summary: Douglas Ruas was elected governor of Rio de Janeiro following a retabulation of votes.

stories.title: Campanha de Lula vê interferência da Meta após vídeos de Lula baterem recorde de visualizações

en.title: Lula campaign sees Meta interference after Lula videos break viewership records
en.summary: Lula's campaign identified Meta interference following videos of Lula that achieved record viewership numbers.

stories.title: Com gol de bicicleta, seleção feminina ganha com facilidade da Argentina

en.title: With a bicycle kick, women's national team easily beats Argentina
en.summary: Brazil's women's national team defeated Argentina with a dominant performance, including a goal scored with a bicycle kick.

stories.title: UPDATE1: Campanha do Lula acusa Meta de 'privilegiar conteúdo da direita' e aciona TSE

en.title: UPDATE1: Lula's campaign accuses Meta of 'favoring right-wing content' and files complaint with TSE
en.summary: President Lula's campaign filed a complaint with Brazil's Superior Electoral Court against Meta over problems with paid content promotion on the company's social networks. The campaign coordination alleges the company failed to explain the issues and plans to contact the National Data Protection Agency.

stories.title: Em ato evangélico, Flávio Bolsonaro diz que Brasil vive ‘guerra espiritual’

en.title: At evangelical event, Flávio Bolsonaro says Brazil is experiencing 'spiritual war'
en.summary: PL presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro stated at an evangelical gathering that Brazil faces spiritual warfare against deceitful enemies. He participated in a celebration marking the centenary of the Assemblies of God Ministry of Madureira in Rio de Janeiro.

stories.title: TSE dá 48 horas para Meta explicar suposta restrição a anúncios da campanha de Lula

en.title: TSE gives Meta 48 hours to explain alleged restriction on Lula campaign ads
en.summary: Brazil's Superior Electoral Court ordered Meta to provide explanations within 48 hours regarding alleged failures in distributing Lula campaign content and advertising. Minister Marco Aurélio Bellizze demanded technical data on metrics, inauthentic accounts, and content recommendation rules.

stories.title: Estudantes protestam após retotalização de votos para governo do Rio, que coloca Douglas Ruas à frente

en.title: Students protest after vote recount for Rio governor position that places Douglas Ruas ahead
en.summary: Students staged a demonstration outside Rio's Regional Electoral Court headquarters protesting the vote recount for governor. Around 30 protesters called for a runoff in the state elections held on October 4.

stories.title: TRE-RJ confirma Douglas Ruas, do PL, como governador eleito do Rio

en.title: TRE-RJ confirms Douglas Ruas, from PL, as elected governor of Rio
en.summary: Brazil's Regional Electoral Court confirmed Douglas Ruas as the winner of Rio de Janeiro's gubernatorial election with 50.88% of valid votes. The official announcement will be made on October 15.
